fix(js): trap focus in detached mode (#1374)

* fix(js): trap focus in detached mode

* fix(js): include editable controls in detached focus navigation

* fix: contain native Safari Tab navigation in detached mode

* refactor(js): simplify detached focus trap

Drop the Safari focus guards, contenteditable handling and the
inert/visibility filtering, in line with the DocSearch approach.
Keep the Tab wrap, Escape via the core handler and Ctrl/Cmd+Tab
passthrough.
